name: Raquel Pereira-Carmago
source: Raquel is passionate, borderline obsessed about soccer! A promising athlete in the Athletics department, she’s energetic, ambitious and has no time for any crap. Raquel is the most direct and honest student in Arlington, making her the most popular student in school. Raquel is always in it for the win, and is loads of fun… when she doesn’t get caught!
